verdict.rationale: Vanta documents questionnaire automation. It drafts answers from your knowledge base and past questionnaires, and its agentic workflows run 'from start to finish' so you only 'review, approve, and submit'. That implies taking questionnaires in and sending them back out, and API endpoints manage Customer Trust questionnaire responses. But nothing names supported import or export formats, or says the output keeps the format the customer sent. Missing for 10: explicit SIG/CAIQ support, spreadsheet import and export, customer-portal handling, and export in the customer's original format, plus any independent or hands-on corroboration.
